Compiled on 5.28.23
Extremely difficult security to work with once inside the venue results in a not so great tape. Thank you Zach Semcken for doing the hard work for us to have recordings of this fantastic show.

23 years ago, I taped my first DMB show on my 20th birthday here at Riverbend. That was also the day I met my first DMB friends in person and returning with many of those same people feels incredible. Thanks to everyone in this community for keeping me in this thing so many years later. <3
